text:
ivy: Quick thread Migration windows & SLA playbook — we agreed relay default, opt-in egress, peering later. Missing: a standard migration-window API and how that ties to SLA language and CS scheduling. Need one small, operator-friendly surface.

sam: Field asks: customers want a scheduled cutover that aligns to their maintenance windows (e.g., 02:00-04:00 local) plus a preferred fallback window. We should provide a declarative endpoint so CS can schedule without manual infra tickets.

ben: API sketch idea (dry-run + schedule):
```
POST /v1/tenants/:tid/migrations
{ "target_mode":"egress","start_iso":"2025-06-12T02:00:00-07:00","end_iso":"2025-06-12T04:00:00-07:00","dry_run":true }
# returns {"ok":"true","expected_downtime_ms":"0","warnings":["egress-ip-not-verified"]}
```
We should keep dry_run mandatory for first GA calls.

field-ana: Good. Also require customer-provided contacts and a CS playbook checklist attachment (pre-cutover test URL, expected responses, rollback criteria). CS needs a one-click cancel if things go sideways.

ivy: SLA implications: migrations that cause escalations outside scheduled window should be blamed to the customer if they requested the time. We need explicit consent checkbox and audit log entries. Also define acceptable performance regression during migration (suggest: request_error_rate delta <= 0.5% and 99p latency delta <= 30ms).

ben: Add these to the API response and Console: validation outcome, risk score (low/med/high), estimated relay-cost-delta, and required approvals. Example approval flow: auto-approve if risk=low, manual if high.

sam: Packaging note: the agent must support a graceful drain API: `POST /agent/:id/drain?timeout=30s` and a probe-warm state that marks migration complete only after KV-warm secs. Add these steps to the playbook.

field-ana: CS playbook bullets to include in the migration object: pre-cutover smoke test, after-cutover sanity URL, rollback trigger list, customer contact, maintenance-window tz. Also a template message for customers.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created draft doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/migration-window-playbook (edit access) :robot_face:

ivy: Acceptance criteria for this feature (GA scope):
- Declarative migration API with dry-run and schedule support
- Console shows scheduled windows, validation, risk score, and audit trail
- Agent-side drain + warm primitives implemented and exercised in staging
- CS playbook templates + one-click cancel and manual-override in Console
- SLA language updated with migration consent clause and regression thresholds

ben: Action items: I'll wire the API + dry-run responses; Sam -> agent drain/warm endpoints; Ana -> CS templates and contact flow; Ivy -> update SLA text and add consent checkbox mock. We'll demo in the next roadmap review.

(ended)
